notes: Measured-video-only profile. Original filename templates and mode/channel token meanings are not validated. No rules imported from E1 Pro.
Firmware VT-EFI242 applies to all five owner configurations. Quality and HDR stay unspecified unless explicitly supplied. Hardware production/prototype status is unknown.
Playback duration and nominal FPS are not real elapsed capture time. Owner-reported mixed modes within files are unverified. No parking power or wake timing is measured.

Normal-folder driving comparison includes only playback duration >=30 seconds and video-track bitrate >30 Mbps. Short and anomalous clips remain separate. These thresholds do not establish TurboBoot status or prove ordinary driving.
Historical E1 Pro history and rcg530 Standard HDR prototype measurements remain separate.
